sources.location: RAW headers read by HTTP range request (instrument, method file, activation type; scratchpad/PXD031395/evidence/raw_header_check.json)

claims.value: anti-HA IP from HA::PAQR-2 worms vs paqr-2 mutant control worms; Rd.1 on QE HF (80/83), Rd.2 on Fusion (#1 = 21/32, #2 = 23/34, each injected twice)
claims.evidence: RAW '2920 HA', '2920 PaQv-2 mut', '3142 #1', '3142 #1 inj 7 uL' …; msf 2920_HA / 2920_PaQr-2_mut, 3142_HA_…_21_32, 3142_mut_…_23_34; paper: HA tag at the N-terminus of the endogenous PAQR-2 locus; controls are 'worms or cells that do not express HA-tagged proteins'

claims.value: control (no HA) / HA-AdipoR2 / HA-AdipoR2 + palmitic acid, two rounds (190823_02/05/08 and 190911_38/41/44)
claims.evidence: RAW '3234 IP ctl', '3234 IP R2-HA', '3234 IP R2-HA PA', '3256 04/05/06'; msf 3256_ctl/R2-HA/R2-HA-PA; paper: 'stable clones of HEK293 cells carrying a HA::AdipoR2 expression construct'; 'HEK293 fatty acid treatment: Palmitic acid … for 24 h'

claims.value: QE HF HCD 28 (C. elegans Rd.1, all HEK293); Orbitrap Fusion ion-trap CID 35 (C. elegans Rd.2)
claims.evidence: RAW models and methods; PRIDE protocol

claims.value: Methylthio C fixed, Oxidation M variable; 5 ppm; 0.2 Da (C. elegans) / 0.03 Da (human); DTT; MMTS; trypsin

limitations: Two SDRF files because the two organisms need different templates: PXD031395-celegans.sdrf.tsv (6 runs) and PXD031395-hek293.sdrf.tsv (6 runs).

The C. elegans control is labelled 'PaQv-2 mut'/'mut'; it is annotated as 'paqr-2 mutant' (allele not stated). The HA strain is paqr-2(syb364[HA::paqr-2]) per the paper. characteristics[bait] names the tagged bait protein (HA::PAQR-2 / HA::AdipoR2; 'not applicable' for controls). The pull-down antibody (rabbit anti-HA C29F4, RRID:AB_1549585 per the paper) is not in the SDRF.

'PA' in the HEK293 sample names ('3234 IP R2-HA PA', msf 'R2-HA-PA') is read as palmitic-acid treatment; the IP methods do not describe it, so dose and duration are not annotated (treatment 'palmitic acid' vs 'untreated').
The Rd.2 Fusion runs 21/32 (HA) and 23/34 (control) are two injections of the same IP (sample names '#1'/'#1 inj 7 uL'); annotated as technical replicates 1 and 2.
The PRIDE protocol mentions an 'Rd.1 PAQR-1' experiment; no RAW file for it is deposited.
